title: 第一卷 第29章 格局颠覆，重新洗牌！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
姜无痕一开口，在场众人的目光，纷纷落在了他的身上。

    他看向众人，不急不缓的开口道：“在我们大张旗鼓的驾驭炎阳仙舟，前往创生莲华界的那一刻，计划就已经开始了！”

    “各方大势力在彼此的地界安插眼线，这几乎是约定俗成的潜规则。此番接回小世界姐妹花的消息，势必要传遍各大势力。不过，这对他们来说，算不上什么重要信息，并不会引起高层的关注。”

    “所以，需要我们添一把火！”

    姜无痕轻笑，看向了姜临天，开口道：“家主，立刻对外宣布，姜家帝子于明日再纳道侣，对方是来自下方小世界的三生阁圣主安祈雪及其妹妹安兮兮，并广邀各方强者前来观礼。”

    “放心吧，无痕，这件事我来安排！”

    姜临天点头道。

    “如此一来，这对姐妹花的身份，必将受到各方强者的关注！”姜无痕目光深邃，侃侃而谈，“接下来，我们要放出足以让所有人震撼且疯狂的重磅消息。动用姜家底蕴，助安祈雪和安兮兮血脉升华，成就圣体！”

    这是之前在祖地就商量好的，也是这个计划的关键。

    当然，提前放出消息，只是为了造势。

    “到时候，各种猜疑满天飞，质疑声将会成为主流，并不断发酵。等到舆论压力达到顶峰时，让沐云溪、安祈雪、安兮兮三女接连服下天圣丹，并动用姜家的‘映照诸天’祭台，用这些真实画面，终结质疑声，让舆论成为真实！”

    “而姜家，势必会遭到各方势力觊觎。这时候，就需要家族展示出足以震慑万族的实力底蕴，让那些觊觎，变成真正的忌惮，甚至敬畏！”

    姜无痕看向五位长老，轻笑道：“到时，还需要各位老祖出面。无需动手，只需要释放帝威，昭告这片天地，我姜家除了我父亲恒御大帝，还有五尊当世大帝的底蕴！”

    “小无痕，你放心，倘若只是威慑宵小，根本无需破封出关。”始祖点头，脸上却闪过一抹担忧，“只怕这么做，虽能震慑弱者，却也容易激起某些同样自封的老家伙的逆反心理。”

    “若其他势力的大帝携极道帝兵而来，我们五位……也不得不有人破封迎战！”

    他们虽是镇压了一个时代的大帝，如今却寿元将尽。

    倘若破封出战，无论这一战的结果如何，都逃不过陨落的结局。

    “倘若真到了那一刻，就由老夫出战吧！”始祖没有丝毫犹豫，开口道，“老夫自封的时间的最长，神源的承受能力，也已经快要到达极限了。”

    “待我陨落之后，姜家的未来……就靠尔等守护了！”

    始祖看向众人，脸上露出欣慰的笑。

    “始祖，你是我们五个之中境界最高的，也是最见多识广的存在。这种事无论如何……也轮不到您来做！”二祖起身，沉声道，“您的神源，再封千年也没什么问题。”

    “这一战，由我来！”

    二祖一开口，其他三位老祖也纷纷起身，主动请缨出战。

    姜无痕见状，连忙解释道：“各位老祖别激动，此事无需你们出手。让家主传讯，请我父亲回归坐镇。即便有外族大帝携极道帝兵而来，强弩之末……又怎敌巅峰大帝？”

    “除非其他势力联手，不顾一切的想要毁掉姜家。但这样做，对他们没有半点好处！”
content_en:
As soon as Jiang Wuhen opened his mouth, the eyes of everyone present fell on him.

    He looked at the crowd and spoke calmly: "The moment we drove the Flame Sun Immortal Boat to the Lotus Realm of Creation with great fanfare, the plan had already started!"

    "It is almost an unspoken rule that the major forces of all parties place spies in each other's territories. The news of taking back the sisters from the small world is bound to spread to all the major forces. However, this is not important information to them and will not attract the attention of high-level officials."

    "So, we need to add some fire!"

    Jiang Wuhen chuckled lightly, looked at Jiang Lintian, and said: "Master of the family, immediately announce to the outside world that the emperor of the Jiang family will receive another Taoist companion tomorrow. The other party is An Qixue, the Holy Master of Sansheng Pavilion, and his sister An Xixi from the small world below. We also invite powerful people from all over the world to come and watch the ceremony."

    "Don't worry, Wuhen, I will arrange this!"

    Jiang Lintian nodded.

    "In this way, the identity of these sisters will definitely attract the attention of powerful people from all sides!" Jiang Wuhen said with deep eyes, "Next, we will release a big news that will shock everyone and make everyone crazy. Use the Jiang family's heritage to help An Qixue and An Xixi's bloodline sublime and achieve the Holy Body!"

    This was discussed in the ancestral land before, and it is also the key to this plan.

    Of course, releasing the news in advance is just to build momentum.

    "At that time, all kinds of suspicions will fly all over the sky, and doubts will become the mainstream and continue to ferment. When the pressure of public opinion reaches its peak, let Mu Yunxi, An Qixue, and An Xixi take the Heavenly Holy Pill one after another, and use the Jiang family's 'Reflecting the Heavens' altar. Use these real pictures to end the doubts and make public opinion true!"

    "And the Jiang family is bound to be coveted by all forces. At this time, the family needs to show its strength and foundation that can intimidate all races, so that those who covet it will become real fear, and even awe!"

    Jiang Wuhen looked at the five elders and chuckled: "At that time, all the ancestors will still need to come forward. No need to take action, just release the emperor's power and tell this world that in addition to my father, Emperor Hengyu, my Jiang family has the heritage of five great emperors in the world!"

    "Xiao Wuhen, don't worry. If it's just to intimidate Xiao Xiao, there's no need to break the seal and leave." The ancestor nodded, but a flash of worry flashed across his face, "I'm afraid that although doing this can frighten the weak, it may also easily arouse the rebellious psychology of some old guys who are also self-proclaimed."

    "If the great emperors of other forces come with the Ji Dao Emperor's soldiers, the five of us...someone will have to break the seal and fight!"

    Although they suppressed the great emperor for an era, their lifespan is now about to expire.

    If we break the seal and go to fight, no matter what the outcome of this battle is, we will not be able to escape the ending of death.

    "If that moment really comes, let me fight!" The ancestor said without any hesitation, "I have been self-proclaimed for the longest time, and the endurance of the divine source has almost reached its limit."

    "After I die, the future of the Jiang family... depends on you and others to protect it!"

    The ancestor looked at everyone with a happy smile on his face.

    "Ancestor, you are the one with the highest realm among the five of us, and the most knowledgeable being. No matter what, it is not your turn to do this kind of thing!" The second ancestor stood up and said in a deep voice, "There is no problem in sealing your divine source for another thousand years."

    "This battle is up to me!"

    As soon as the second ancestor spoke, the other three ancestors also stood up and volunteered to fight.

    Seeing this, Jiang Wuhen quickly explained: "Ancestors, don't get excited, there is no need for you to take action in this matter. Let the head of the family send a message and ask my father to return and take charge. Even if a foreign emperor comes with the Ji Dao emperor's soldiers, how can he defeat the peak emperor at the end of the powerful crossbow..."

    "Unless other forces join forces and desperately want to destroy the Jiang family. But doing so will not do them any good!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 29 The pattern is overturned and the cards are reshuffled!
